text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position throughout and repeated claim that driverless cars are \"for the better\"","quality":"argumentative stance","description":"The essay maintains a consistent, explicit position and keeps returning to the same central claim."},{"evidence":"uses fuel, pollution, crash, and liability points from the article","quality":"use of evidence","description":"The essay supports its claims with several relevant details drawn from the source text."},{"evidence":"\"This would benefit everyone...\" then explains pollution, flexibility, safety, and consumer value","quality":"development","description":"The essay expands on each idea with explanation instead of just naming a point."},{"evidence":"\"A counter argument... is the law\" followed by fault and safety questions","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges a possible objection and responds to it rather than ignoring it."},{"evidence":"intro, body paragraphs, and a concluding restatement of the position","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay follows a clear argumentative structure with introduction, supporting body, and conclusion."}]}
